The Mobile Infantry garrison in Mahanagar has been dispatched to the northern district to deal with a troublesome outbreak of Arachnids.

After touching down near the local railway station, Major Verhaegen leads his troopers with the objective of clearing the streets by sunrise.

They ain't stopping... but neither do we, soldiers! Keep pushing!
Listen up! Bugs have breached the northern district and got the cops here struggling. You know what that means...
Those of you joining us for the first time will learn quick that Major Verhaegen's boys are the best Bug stompin' detail in the M.I.
Intel informs me we've got a large concentration of Bugs around the train lines. So our next stop, the railway station!
Uphold my sterling reputation, troopers. We're moving out!

column2: Blast! Clearing them out caused the tunnel collapse.
We'll need to find a side way in over that rail line.

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/CLEAR THE TUNNEL TO GET TO THE STATION/BRIEFING ==============

column2: Bug nest ahead! We'll need to flush out that tunnel to get into the station.
Mobile Infantry? Finally, a bit of support.
You must be Officer Keys? Major Verhaegen, here to take over from you folks. This is M.I. business now.
Does "M.I. business" include getting our civilians evacuated out of the district?
My prime objective is killin' Bugs. But if that helps you complete the civilian evac, you can tag along.
That's good enough for me. Hives are this way.
Arrrgh!

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/DEFEND THE RAILWAY PLATFORMS/TRIGGERS/OFFENSIVE MANAGER/RANDOM ARRIVAL MESSAGE/OPTIONS/SPEECH C ==============

column2: Right on cue. Hit them!
Well I'll be... there's your Bugs, Keys. Getting real curious how you knew they were coming...
Just a cop with good intuition. What else do you expect me to be?
"Intuition", huh? Hmm...
More Bugs on the move!
Aw hell. The cop might have been right...
Keys? I'm tracking a massive Bug horde on its way to you. We're also getting reports right across the city too!
I'll give it to you this time, your "intuition" might have been on the money. This is big.
I'll take my apology in the form of some back up for that horde!
On it.
All civvies packed away -- we're clear.
We're needed elsewhere, Keys. The situation is spiraling fast. I understand that this is your district, but I got a feeling you might be a real help, so if you're wanting to--
--I'm with you, Major. Let's hunt some Bugs.
Not bad, for flatfoots. Now, if you'll clear out our way, we'll be taking it from here.
We're not going anywhere until every last civilian is on a train out of the district. Is "protect and serve" not a part of the M.I. mission too?
The protection part of my job is clearing out Bug infestations. I'm better served stompin' out the problem before it spreads to more of your people.
You'll still be leaving these people here at risk! I can sense more Bugs on their way!
"Sense"?
You ain't one of those...
Fine. We'll hold. It's a good spot to thin the herd anyway. If there is one...
We're losing civilians! Do better!
The civvies are in trouble! We signed up to protect them!
This is a disgrace to the badge! We have failed in our duty!
Civilians coming in for evac. Help them out!

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/CLEAR ALL HIVES/TRIGGERS:CLEAR ALL HIVES/DIALOGUE: FIRST HIVE CLEARED ==============

column2: Finally, some proper Bug huntin'! Onto the next one!
We've done what you asked, but it's time we shipped off to the next hive.
The Bugs will regroup before long. They've got a Brain Bug corralling them, Major. Was my report passed down?
The sewer sighting? Heh. Yeah. I could see how waste might be mistaken for one of them ugly suckers.
Take this seriously, Major! This attack is not the same as the usual outbreaks.
If you let me get on with my job it will be. Quashed and forgotten, just like the rest. We're moving, soldiers!
Tiger Bugs! We need more firepower for these nasty suckers.
Whoa... Fed Intel was on the money with the brief on Burster Bugs being here. Man, they're ugly bastards!
Bugs on the flank! Tear 'em apart!
Good to see boot camp is still feeding me capable soldiers. Let's push on to the station.
Use all this materiel to put up more defenses!
Why are we not putting all that materiel to use?! Deploy more turrets!
